description:
Project Overview

ICIQ invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within its Fully-Funded PhD Programme 2026 – Third Call. The project, "Design, Synthesis and Application of Circular Polymers" (reference PhD 2026-21 AK), is supervised by Dr. Arjan W. Kleij.

The research focuses on catalytic polymer preparation, recycling, and degradation mechanisms, contributing to the development of sustainable circular polymer systems.

Research position overview

You will work on the design and synthesis of novel polymers with built-in recyclability and degradability, investigating catalytic pathways for polymerisation and depolymerisation. The project connects green chemistry, catalysis, and materials science.

Research Areas

  • Circular polymer design and synthesis
  • Catalytic polymerisation
  • Polymer recycling and degradation
  • Sustainable materials
  • Green chemistry and catalysis
